rules.name: failed-read
rules.message: A signal read failed, so the item cannot be judged green.
rules.question: Which signal read failed, and what does the server actually say for this submission?

rules.name: draft
rules.message: Still a draft; parked until it leaves draft state.

rules.name: changes-requested
rules.question: A reviewer already requested changes — does the current state resolve them, or does the request need a human decision?

rules.name: unmergeable
rules.message: The pull request conflicts with its base.
rules.question: The pull request conflicts with its base — can the author rebase it, or does it need a human?

rules.name: excluded-package
rules.question: The target package is excluded as hand-maintained — does a human need to take this one?

rules.name: security-unclear-scope
rules.message: A security update that changes more than the version.
rules.question: This security update changes more than the version — is the scope what the CVE fix needs?

rules.name: risk-flag-service-files
rules.message: The submission changes a service, link, aggregate, or submodule definition.
rules.question: The submission changes a service, link, aggregate, or submodule definition — is the new source layout intended?

rules.name: risk-flag-macros
rules.message: The submission changes a macros file.
rules.question: The submission changes a macros file — is the new macro set intended?

rules.name: pre-release-version
rules.message: The new version is a pre-release.
rules.question: The new version is a pre-release — is a pre-release acceptable for Factory here?

rules.name: leading-v-version
rules.message: The new version carries a leading v.
rules.question: The new version carries a leading v — is that the upstream versioning, or a packaging slip?

rules.name: review-asked-pending
rules.message: A review was asked and is still pending; parked until it lands.

rules.name: failed-build-submit
rules.message: The submission's build fails while the target project does not fail the same way.
rules.question: The submission's build fails while the target project builds — is the failure the submitter's to fix?

rules.name: failed-build-target
rules.message: The submission's build fails, but the target project fails the same way; parked until the target builds again.

rules.name: build-building
rules.message: The build is still running; parked until it finishes.

rules.name: build-unknown
rules.message: No build evidence (a Gitea pull request, or no signal repository); parked until build evidence appears.

rules.name: clean-bump
rules.message: Version bump only, changelog updated, build green on Tumbleweed and Leap 16, no review outstanding.
